info.title: Open Source Guru API
info.description: Follow labels on GitHub repositories and get notified about matching issues. Authenticate with a personal API key created in the dashboard: `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

session.name: better-auth.session_token
session.description: Browser session from signing in on the website

post.description: Emails you when an issue is opened with one of the labels, or when one of the labels is added to an issue. With no labels, every new issue matches.

channels.description: Defaults to your primary email, instant

parameters.name: before

get.summary: Your Open Source Contributions, newest first
get.description: Commits are reported per repository and day, with their number in `count`. Page with `cursor` (the previous response's `nextCursor`).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: A calendar year; the last 12 months when omitted

get.description: Contributions GitHub counts but that aren't Open Source Contributions: in your own repositories, in forks, or in repositories without an OSI-approved license. Private contributions are only known as a number per calendar year (`private`, null for the last 12 months). Never shown publicly.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: A calendar year; the last 12 months when omitted

post.description: Asks for this year's contributions to be fetched again, within a minute or so. Ignored when the last refresh is less than 15 minutes old or one is already on its way.

requested.description: False when a recent or pending sync makes it unnecessary

get.summary: Your Open Source Contributions at a glance
get.description: Totals, the daily graph, breakdowns by type and repository, recent merged pull requests, streaks and the years available. Only Open Source Contributions count: public, OSI-licensed repositories you don't own.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: A calendar year; the last 12 months when omitted

periods.description: Oldest first; the last is the current period

post.description: Counts Open Source Contributions only. Weekly goals run Sunday to Saturday, monthly goals by calendar month (UTC, like GitHub's graph); one-off goals need `endsOn`.

periods.description: Oldest first; the last is the current period

patch.summary: Change a goal's target, visibility or status
patch.description: To change what a goal measures, set a new goal.

parameters.name: year

get.description: An SVG badge with the Open Source Contributions of the last 12 months and the current streak. Cached for an hour. A grey "not available" badge (404) when the profile doesn't exist or is off.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Background color of the message side (hex or CSS name)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Badge size: small (default), medium, large, or height in pixels (15-100)
